interpretation: Top-2 learned routing has a small paired mean advantage over its frozen control at epoch 5, with no worst-environment improvement. Randomized-route dependence remains only 0.00365, so the result does not yet show that adaptive routing is the cause.
alternative_explanation: Smoother gradients or ordinary optimization, rather than learned conditional assignments, explain the small mean difference.
sharp_falsifier: E4 or E16 top-2 learned/frozen pairs that fail to reproduce the learned advantage, or continued route reliance below 0.01, rule out a robust adaptive-routing interpretation.
multiplicity: This is one seed within a broader short-run search and is not promoted to a longer horizon.
